chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Bakr ibn Salih, from Malik ibn A'sham, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'Marry the woman who is large-eyed, dark-haired, tall/slender, and of average height (or not too tall); if you dislike her (for these traits), then the dowry is on me.'

key_terms.الصَّدَاقُ: The dowry (mahr) given to the wife
key_terms.عَجْزَاءَ: Of moderate height or not too tall (sometimes contrasted with tall)
key_terms.مَرْبُوعَةً: Tall, slender, or well-proportioned in height

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended physical characteristics for a wife according to this hadith from the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) conveys a recommendation from Imam Ali (peace be upon him) to marry women characterized by large eyes, dark hair, and a slender build, with the term 'ajza’ often interpreted as moderate height or lack of excessive stature. The promise of the Imam covering the dowry if the husband dislikes these traits highlights the spiritual merit and divine guarantee associated with following this specific marital preference, reflecting the Shia emphasis on aesthetic and physical compatibility as part of a blessed union. This narration is frequently cited in Shia jurisprudence to discuss the criteria for selecting a spouse, balancing physical attraction with religious virtue.
